title: Rav Chanan bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sanhedrin 97b he sent to Rav Yosef: “I found a man who had a scroll in his hand … and he said: I hired myself out to the Roman armies, and I found it among the Roman archives, and in it was written: Four thousand two hundred and ninety-one years after the creation of the world, the world will be orphaned,” etc. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Anan bar Tachlifa, and Seder HaDorot arrived at this reading on its own. Hyman says this is the only time that the count of years from creation is mentioned in the Talmud.

notes.text: The sole-attestation statement about creation-era dating is Hyman’s observation, not a fresh exhaustive Talmud search. The supplied 4291 and Chanan/Anan variants are preserved.
